prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1050; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the sideswipe collision you were involved in while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing right before the impact.

A: I was driving on the main road in Katy, in the right lane. I was getting ready to move over to the left lane because traffic was slowing ahead of me and I needed to get over for my exit.

Q: Did you check your mirrors and signal before you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and I put my signal on. I didn't see anything in the left lane right beside me when I looked, but then I started to move over.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other car came up fast in the left lane and clipped the side of my vehicle. I heard a loud scrape and felt my car jerk toward the median. I gripped the wheel and got it under control.

Q: Did your vehicle leave the roadway or hit anything else?

A: No, I stayed on the road. I pulled over onto the shoulder after that.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: Not great. My head hit the window pretty hard. I've had a headache since then, I feel foggy sometimes, and bright lights bother my eyes. My doctor has me resting and I'm not supposed to drive much right now.

Q: Did you seek medical attention at the scene or afterward?

A: Paramedics checked me at the scene, and I went to the emergency room later that day. They told me I have a concussion and gave me instructions to follow.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want my vehicle repaired and to get back to normal.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the statement.
